info.title: The router API (massrelay.ai)
info.description: Generated by tools/api/openapi.mjs from the served routers. Do not edit.

session.description: A signed-in session; the roles allowed per door are in x-massrelay-roles.

schema.description: Hand-written, read against me_spending in crates/mr-server/src/routes.rs (and PauseStateDto, TopUpIntentDto, SkippedRunDto in crates/mr-kernel/src/spending.rs). A session credential. With no personal workspace the page is empty (topUpPolicy is then absent).

Hand-written, read against me_wallets in crates/mr-server/src/routes.rs and WalletRow in crates/mr-kernel/src/wallets.rs. A session credential. A person with no personal workspace yet gets an empty list, not an error. Amounts are in mu (the unit of account).

Hand-written, read against public_models_list in crates/mr-server/src/public_models.rs. No credential. 404 when the public pages are switched off. `floor` is the k-floor: a figure backed by fewer calls is null, never a small number.

Hand-written, read against public_models_detail in crates/mr-server/src/public_models.rs. 404 {error:not_found} for a name the catalogue and the partner listing do not know. Latency and uptime are null below the k-floor.

Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/object (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct chat_completion_body in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (streaming responses are server-sent events and are not described here). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.

id.description: chatcmpl-<decisionId>; the decision id is the key of GET /v1/route/explain/{decisionId}.

schema.description: Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct ChatBody in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (for example n, stop, top_p, seed are ignored). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.

model.description: A model id or an alias from GET /v1/models. Optional: the key's routing decides when absent.

content.description: Text; the gateway reads the text of a message.

messages.description: Required and non-empty; an empty or missing list is a 400.

tools.description: Carried and forwarded verbatim upstream; never validated here.

reasoning_effort.description: The o-series field; read as the request's effort.

schema.description: Read against crates/mr-gateway/src/key_doors.rs `credits_inner`. The wallets are the key's workspace's own (owner kind workspace).

freeAllowanceLeft.description: requests left in this month's free allowance; null when the plan has none

schema.description: Read against crates/mr-gateway/src/key_doors.rs `generation_inner`. 404 decision_not_found for another key's, another workspace's or a missing id.

Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct messages_body in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (streaming is not described here). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.

Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct MessagesBody in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (for example top_p, top_k, stop_sequences, tools are not read on this surface). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.

system.description: A string, or a list of {type:text,text} blocks (joined). An empty list contributes nothing.

thinking.description: This gateway reads a plain effort string, or an object with an effort field; it does not translate Anthropic's budget_tokens block.

schema.description: Hand-written. Mirrors the OpenAI list-models shape (https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/models/list, read 2026-10-11) plus the massrelay extension block, read against models_inner in crates/mr-gateway/src/routes.rs. Served for an L1 key; any other key layer answers 501 not_ported. The massrelay keys listed are those the handler inserts; a key appears only when its source row exists.

id.description: A model id, or an alias name (after the models).

ownedBy.description: Present only for the workspace's own model.

schema.description: Hand-written, read against crates/mr-gateway/src/routes.rs `policy` -> authenticated_not_ported -> not_ported. Today the door authenticates the key and then answers 501; it returns no policy document. The shape below is that 501 body, stated so a caller does not expect more.

Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/object (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct responses_body in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (streaming is not described here). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.

Hand-written. Mirrors the public reference https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/create (read 2026-10-11), reduced to the fields this gateway reads: struct ResponsesBody in crates/mr-gateway/src/wire.rs. Every other field is accepted and not read (tools and previous_response_id are not read on this surface). Fields the gateway does not read are not documented as honoured.

input.description: Required: a string or a list of {role?, content} items (role defaults to user).

instructions.description: Becomes a leading system message; blank text contributes nothing.

schema.description: Hand-written, read against explain_for_key in crates/mr-gateway/src/decisions.rs (the GatewayExplainDto plus the MC-1b/RT-2 additions). 404 decision_not_found for an unknown id or another workspace's id. The `explain` scope is required on the key.
Read against crates/mr-gateway/src/key_doors.rs `usage_body`. Query: from, to (ISO date or datetime, default the UTC calendar month), end_user (one tag), group_by=end_user (one row per tag).
